verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a voice AI platform with a CLI, SDK and open-source framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a setting, flag, or environment variable for disabling telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting, data residency and the call-summary toggle are adjacent controls, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
